description: An enormous capital on a 768 m stage, built in rings. Farmland, orchards, quarries, lakes and a ruined old town fill the countryside; a great eight-gated wall encloses the new city with its circus, theatre, docks and insulae; an older Republican circuit holds the forum and the ancient core; and a walled citadel crowns the sacred mountain behind the whole thing, where the healers keep the temples.
name: Aurelia Magna
theme: Three walls, nine gates, and every field outside them.
